solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Reverse record arrears

parts.note: to reverse a car is to back it
a log is a written record, as a ship's log

explanation.surface: An instruction to undo a record of money owed, as if wiping a debt off the books.
explanation.definitionFit: A pile of work or payments still outstanding is a synonym for arrears, things fallen behind.

clue.text: Use computer-generated image to go after man

indicators.note: to go after says the image's letters follow the man's

parts.note: Ben is a man's name
an E-fit is a computer-built likeness of a suspect, used by British police

explanation.surface: Using a police computer picture to hunt down a suspect.
explanation.walkthrough: An E-fit is the British police's computer-built likeness of a wanted person; 'to go after' sounds like a chase but only sets the order.
explanation.definitionFit: Use in the sense of advantage or good derived from something is the same as an advantage gained.

clue.text: Soothing fellow politician with nothing to confess

parts.note: co- is the prefix for a fellow, as in co-worker
MP is a Member of Parliament
O looks like zero, nothing
to sing is slang for informing or confessing to the police

explanation.surface: A calming colleague, a politician who has no secrets to own up to.
explanation.definitionFit: Calming or settling someone, as in composing oneself, is the soothing sense.

clue.text: Amateur ahead in scoring makes reserve

parts.note: lay means non-professional, as a layman
a team that is up is ahead on the scoreboard

explanation.surface: An amateur side leading the scores becomes the reserve team.
explanation.definitionFit: To put by or store away for later is to keep in reserve, the phrasal verb's sense here.

clue.text: Appreciation for doctor urged to accept carrying on

indicators.note: to accept says the altered letters take the next piece inside
to doctor is to tamper with, so the word urged is altered in order

parts.note: someone at it is carrying on with something

explanation.surface: Thanks for a doctor who urged someone to accept carrying on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doctor' is the anagram signal, not the physician, and 'to accept' is the container signal; 'for' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: Thankfulness, the warm feeling of being thankful, is appreciation in this sense.

clue.text: Keen agency backs imprisoning outspoken Balkan resident

indicators.note: imprisoning says the reversed agency holds the next piece inside it
backs says the agency's letters run the other way

parts.note: the CIA is the American intelligence agency

indicators.note: outspoken says the Balkan resident's word is taken as it sounds when spoken

parts.note: a Serb lives in Serbia, in the Balkans

explanation.surface: A spy agency supports locking up a Balkan dissident who speaks his mind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backs' turns the agency round and 'outspoken' signals a sound-alike; 'imprisoning' puts that sound-alike between A and IC.
explanation.definitionFit: Keen here is sharp or cutting in tone, as a biting wit is, which is what an acid, caustic remark is.

clue.text: Scrutinise vehicle manufacturer over introduction of tachographs

indicators.note: over, in a down answer, puts the maker above the letter that follows

parts.note: Audi is a German car maker

indicators.note: introduction of takes the opening letter of the word tachographs

explanation.surface: Checking a car firm's records once tachographs, lorry drivers' hours recorders, are brought in.
explanation.definitionFit: To inspect accounts or records officially is to scrutinise them closely.

clue.text: Entire three centuries turned out different from normal

indicators.note: turned out says the letters come out in a new order

parts.note: C is a hundred in Roman numerals, so three centuries give three Cs

explanation.surface: A whole three hundred years proved to be unusual.
explanation.definitionFit: Odd or unconventional, departing from what is usual, is what different from normal says.

clue.text: After the bar emptied Sinatra regularly used to smoke tobacco

indicators.note: emptied keeps only the outside letters of the word bar
regularly takes every other letter of the name Sinatra

explanation.surface: Once the bar cleared, Frank Sinatra would light up.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition stands for a thing used for smoking: a pipe carved from heath root.
explanation.definitionFit: A tobacco pipe made from the root of the white heath shrub bears that plant's name.

clue.text: Call in question international support for prisoner

indicators.note: support for, in a down answer, puts the international beneath the prisoner

parts.note: a con is a convict, a prisoner
a Test is an international cricket or rugby match

explanation.surface: An appeal to question international backing for a detainee.
explanation.definitionFit: To dispute or challenge a result is to call it in question.

clue.text: I'm extremely begrudgingly behind new protester against local development

indicators.note: behind says the first pieces come after the abbreviation for new
extremely takes only the outermost letters of the word begrudgingly

explanation.surface: Someone grudgingly falls in behind a new campaigner against a building scheme near them.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is the acronym 'not in my back yard', for someone who objects to building near their own home.
explanation.definitionFit: The acronym names a resident who opposes a planned building project only because it is near their home.

clue.text: Bad work by copper turning into arrangment for forcible removal

indicators.note: work as a verb means to shape or knead, so the letters of the word Bad are reworked
turning says the copper symbol is read the other way round

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

indicators.note: arrangement says the letters of the word into are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A crooked policeman's bad job is turned into a plan for removing someone by force.
explanation.walkthrough: 'work' rearranges BAD to ABD, 'turning' makes CU into UC, and 'arrangment' rearranges INTO to TION. The clue misspells 'arrangement'.
explanation.definitionFit: Kidnapping is taking a person away by force or deception, which is exactly a forcible removal.

clue.text: Pay for advertising in time to make an impression

parts.note: to foot the bill is to pay for it
PR, public relations, is publicity work like advertising

explanation.surface: Paying for an advertising campaign promptly to make your mark on people.
explanation.definitionFit: The mark a foot leaves pressed into the ground is literally an impression, as in mud or snow.

clue.text: Sauce is not initially put on the table without trimmings

indicators.note: initially takes just the opening letter of the word not
without trimmings says the word loses its first and last letters

parts.note: food put on the table has been served

explanation.surface: A sauce that is not, at first, set out on the table bare of garnish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without trimmings' cuts SERVED down to ERVE. 'Sauce' means cheek here, not a condiment.
explanation.definitionFit: Sauce in the sense of cheeky impudence is the same as having the gall or audacity to do something.

clue.text: Visit to Europe is rubbish

parts.note: a trip is a short visit somewhere

explanation.surface: A grumble that a holiday to the continent was dreadful.
explanation.definitionFit: The word for cow's stomach lining is also slang for nonsense or worthless stuff, so it means rubbish.

clue.text: Executioners scattered after taking away our life

indicators.note: scattered says the letters of Executioners are spread into a new order
after taking away says the letters of our are removed before rearranging

explanation.surface: Executioners dispersing after ending a life, grim as it reads.
explanation.walkthrough: Take O, U, R out of EXECUTIONERS and rearrange the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Being alive, simply being, is what life and this word for being both name.

clue.text: Support me to develop at top level

indicators.note: to develop is to grow into a new form, so the letters take a new order

explanation.surface: Backing someone so they can rise to the highest rank.
explanation.definitionFit: Highest or topmost in position, so something at the top level is the one placed highest of all.

clue.text: Singer cancels midway in a fit of pique

parts.note: Petula Clark is an English singer

indicators.note: midway takes the letters at the centre of the word cancels

explanation.surface: A singer calls off a show halfway through in a sulk.
explanation.walkthrough: Only the middle three letters of CANCELS are taken.
explanation.definitionFit: Sulky irritability, a peevish fit of temper, is what a fit of pique shows.

clue.text: Evidence of weariness in obvious mistake

indicators.note: in says the sigh goes inside the word for obvious

parts.note: overt means open, obvious
a sigh shows tiredness

explanation.surface: A tired sigh in the middle of an obvious blunder.
explanation.definitionFit: A slip made by failing to notice something is an unintentional mistake or error.

clue.text: Failing to pay attention to nightwear ends in embarassment

parts.note: a negligee, also spelt neglige, is a light dressing gown worn at night

indicators.note: ends takes the final letter of each of the words in and embarassment

explanation.surface: Not noticing your sleepwear, which ends in red-faced awkwardness.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue misspells 'embarrassment'; it does not affect the final T.
explanation.definitionFit: Careless is the sense: someone remiss in their duties fails to pay attention to what they should.

clue.text: Vagrant mother appears at end of drama about detectives

indicators.note: appears at end of places the mother after the drama

parts.note: No, or Noh, is classical Japanese drama
ma is mother

indicators.note: about says the detectives' letters are turned round

parts.note: CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, the British police detectives

explanation.surface: A wandering mother turns up at the end of a crime drama about detectives.
explanation.definitionFit: A wandering person with no settled home lives a roaming life, which is vagrant as an adjective.

clue.text: Select the best among mediocre amateurs

indicators.note: among says the letters sit inside the run of the words mediocre amateurs

explanation.surface: Picking the finest players from a run-of-the-mill amateur side.
explanation.definitionFit: To skim off the finest part, as cream is skimmed from milk, is to select the best.

clue.text: Woolly animal ate two dates, died

indicators.note: ate says the animal takes the dates inside it

parts.note: a mule is the animal
D is the abbreviation for date, given twice

explanation.surface: A sheep-like animal ate two dates and died.
explanation.definitionFit: Woolly thinking is confused and unclear, the same as being in a mess mentally.

clue.text: Worth money to return not completely exhausted

parts.note: M is a standard abbreviation for money, as in economists' M1 and M2

indicators.note: to return says the shortened word is read backwards
not completely says the word loses its last letter

parts.note: someone exhausted is tired

explanation.surface: Is the money worth it, coming back not quite worn out?
explanation.walkthrough: 'not completely' cuts TIRED to TIRE; 'to return' reverses it to ERIT.
explanation.definitionFit: Worth in the sense of value or deserving quality is the same as excellence that earns praise.

clue.text: Period before resistance is over

definitions.note: taken as a verb phrase meaning dies down or slackens, the old intransitive sense of abating

indicators.note: over, read a second time, says the whole run of letters is turned round
before says the period's letters come ahead of the resistance symbol

parts.note: a period is a stretch of time
R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: A spell of time ahead of opposition has come to an end.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue is faulty: 'over' must do double duty, turning TIMER round and forming part of the weak definition 'is over', remit's rare sense of abating.
explanation.definitionFit: In the old intransitive sense, a fever or storm that slackens and dies away is said to abate, so it is ending.

clue.text: Paid tribute to soldier buried in ransacked Seoul beside newspaperman

indicators.note: beside says the newspaperman's letters sit next to the rest
buried in says the soldier goes inside the jumbled letters
a ransacked place is turned upside down, so the letters of Seoul are jumbled

parts.note: a GI is an American soldier
ED is short for editor, a newspaperman

explanation.surface: A newspaper editor pays tribute to a soldier buried in a war-torn Seoul.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ransacked' is the anagram signal, making EULOS from the city's name, and the soldier is buried inside that jumble.
explanation.definitionFit: To deliver a speech of high praise, often at a funeral, is to pay tribute to someone.

clue.text: Improve understanding of opposition leader by providing right of reply

parts.note: Ed Miliband was leader of the opposition when the puzzle appeared
providing means if, on condition that

indicators.note: right of takes the right-hand, final letter of the word reply

explanation.surface: Bettering how the opposition leader is understood by granting a right of reply.
explanation.walkthrough: Ed Miliband led the UK Labour opposition in 2014.
explanation.definitionFit: To instruct someone so as to improve them morally or intellectually is to improve their understanding.

clue.text: Prayer addressed to an archbishop possibly?

definitions.meaning: a short thanksgiving said before a meal
Your ... is the form of address for an archbishop or a duke

explanation.surface: Is a prayer something one addresses to an archbishop?
explanation.definitionFit: It is both a mealtime blessing and the style used in addressing archbishops.

clue.text: Factor staff into decision to abandon Europe

indicators.note: into says the staff go inside the shortened word
to abandon says those letters leave the word decision

parts.note: EC, the European Community, stands for Europe
a firm's staff are its men

explanation.surface: Including the workforce in the choice to leave Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to abandon' removes EC, the European Community, leaving DISION; 'into' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An aspect or element of a problem, one factor among several, is a sense of the word for a measurable extent.

clue.text: Spirit shown by blackleg named in revolution

indicators.note: in revolution says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A strikebreaker is named and shamed during an uprising.
explanation.walkthrough: A blackleg is a worker who breaks a strike. The run LEGNA spans 'blackleg named' and is turned round by 'in revolution'.
explanation.definitionFit: A heavenly messenger is a spirit, a being without a body in religious belief.

clue.text: Implements stoppage by the French train service

parts.note: a cut is a stoppage, as in a power cut
le is French for the
RY is the abbreviation for railway, a train service

explanation.surface: A list of what a French rail strike brings about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Implements' looks like a verb (carries out), but it is the noun: tools for eating.
explanation.definitionFit: Knives, forks and spoons are the eating implements this word names collectively.

clue.text: City's Tory leader in England was the first returned

indicators.note: in says these letters go inside the verb for being first

parts.note: whoever was first led the field
EC is the postcode of the City of London

indicators.note: leader takes the opening letter of the word Tory

explanation.surface: A Conservative chief from the City was the first in England to be voted back in.
explanation.definitionFit: A candidate returned to Parliament is one voted in at an election.
